description:
Use this when the user wants their finished clips or saved photos, or needs a clip_id: "show me my clips",
"what shorts did you make". Returns each id, title, source project and its seconds in the original video.
Not for: the long videos (list_projects) or a gallery with players (show_clips). Free and read only.
